name: rendering-normals
skip_reason: Offscreen Camera framebuffers under --no-rendering contain only the viewport clear color (=Background.skyColor), not the rendered scene geometry. With atmosphericSky in the world the clear is (4,4,4) so all 7 cameras are byte-identical and every diff is 0; the diff(c0,c6) > 10000 assertion fails. Replacing atmosphericSky with a plain skyColor only flips the test outcome based on whether edge-antialiasing of the cleared rect happens to exceed 10000 (passes at [0.9,0.1,0.1] -> diff 15714; fails at [0.5,0.5,0.5] -> diff 3421) -- no actual geometry shading is captured either way. The atmospheric-sky migration just exposed this -- the pre-migration cubemap skybox masked the same renderer bug by drawing a photo background. The earlier WbSolidDevice postFinalize NULL-deref crash masked it further by aborting before the assertion. Real fix is in the WREN offscreen camera render path: wr_scene_render_to_viewports() during a controller step needs to actually include scene geometry when the main 3D view's render loop is suppressed. Restore after that is fixed.
